note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; terminal commands are typed and run for real. $env:MG_DEV_URL (DEV org URL) and the other MG_* variables are set by the owner as user environment variables on the laptop and never appear on screen.
prepare: # owner signs in once, off camera: az login --allow-no-subscriptions
Push-Location src; npm ci --no-audit --no-fund; npm run build; Pop-Location
Push-Location src; node provision/provision.ts --webresource dist/contoso_/scripts/loanform.js --role 'Basic User'; Pop-Location
Push-Location src; node provision/provision.ts --webresource dist/contoso_/scripts/loanform.js --role 'Basic User'; Pop-Location

Read-Host 'Owner: in the maker portal add the On Load handler to the Loan main form (library contoso_/scripts/loanform.js, function Contoso.LoanForm.onLoad, Pass execution context ticked), add the missing columns to the form, save and publish; create test equipment CT-0042 Laptop, CT-0107 Monitor, CT-0311 Phone and loans for alex.demo@contoso.com and sam.demo@contoso.com, one due 3 days ago and not returned. Press Enter when done'

screens.name: solution
steps: Pick the DEV environment in the environment picker
Open Solutions
Open the solution 'Equipment Desk'
Stay on Objects: show the tables Equipment and Loan, the app Equipment Desk, the site map and the web resource contoso_/scripts/loanform.js
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu

screens.name: app-designer
steps: Solutions > Equipment Desk
Select the app 'Equipment Desk' > Edit (modern app designer)
Show the navigation: area 'Equipment Desk', group 'Lending', pages Equipment and Loans
Select the Loans page and show the preview with the test loans
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu

screens.name: form-handler
steps: Solutions > Equipment Desk > table Loan > Forms
Open the Loan main form in the form designer
Open Events (form properties)
On Load > + Event handler
Show library contoso_/scripts/loanform.js, function Contoso.LoanForm.onLoad and the 'Pass execution context as first parameter' checkbox ticked (highlight it)
Close the dialog without changing anything
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu

screens.name: due-date-error
steps: Apps > 'Equipment Desk' > Play (the running model-driven app)
Loans > New Loan: show loan date (today) and due date (+14 days) defaulted
Pick equipment CT-0042 Laptop; loan name fills in by itself
Set the due date before the loan date: red field notification 'Due date can't be before the loan date.'
Try Save: it is blocked
Cutaway: open the loan that was due three days ago: yellow banner 'Overdue by 3 days. Contact the borrower.'
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu
any real mail domain: only the fictional *.demo@contoso.com addresses may stay

teardown: Write-Host 'The Equipment Desk solution, tables, app and test data stay for episodes 2-4 and are removed after the series (demo.md tear-down). Run az logout if az was signed in only for this.'
